column1: # sdk/member-names.tsv — every method (M) and field (F) name the SDK declares.
# after adding, removing or renaming an SDK method or field.
# build_support/names.rs turns the rows (with the contract's member column)
# into the `m::` consts (one per name; value = the active shrink map's
# target under --shrink, the original otherwise) that Rust native dispatch,
# the JVM's builtin arms and the lifecycle upcalls match names through.
